name: Function-view probe (Deno runtime req.headers)
piiVerification: Every captured response file was scanned: ZERO IPv4 literals and ZERO IPv6 literals of any kind, sentinel or real. All findings are enums, booleans and counts, plus a 16-bit salted digest used only transiently to test source stability.

B_and_D_caller_supplied_cf_connecting_ip.conclusion: Cloudflare refuses the request at the edge. The function never executes. Confirms Phase A at the Edge Function route specifically.

cf_connecting_ip.echoedSentinel: OTHER_VALUE_NO_SENTINEL on every call - the caller's value never appears
cf_connecting_ip.verdict: TRUSTED. Reaches the Deno runtime, single-valued, and cannot be caller-supplied at all.

x_real_ip.verdict: NOT AVAILABLE AT THE FUNCTION. It appears in the gateway log attribute map but is NOT in req.headers. The x-real-ip cross-check proposed in FDA028-GAB-2 is therefore IMPOSSIBLE to implement as specified.

x_forwarded_for.echoedSentinel: OTHER_VALUE_NO_SENTINEL in cases G, H and I - the caller's supplied value is STRIPPED before the function
x_forwarded_for.verdict: Caller values do not survive to the function, but the 3-element composition is UNDOCUMENTED and UNCHARACTERIZED. Which element is the true client is UNPROVEN. Must not be the primary signal.
x_forwarded_for.note: This differs from the gateway log view, where a caller-supplied XFF WAS recorded. The two observation points are not the same; the function's view is what the design would actually read.

true_client_ip.verdict: FULLY CALLER-FORGEABLE AT THE FUNCTION. Passes through verbatim. MUST NEVER BE USED.

forwarded.verdict: FULLY CALLER-FORGEABLE AT THE FUNCTION. MUST NEVER BE USED.

cf_pseudo_ipv4.verdict: ABSENT - no evidence Pseudo IPv4 is in effect for IPv4 clients

cf_binding.verdict: The Cloudflare Worker request.cf object is NOT reachable from the Supabase Edge Function runtime. P7 answered NO - it cannot be used as a non-forgeable structured anchor.

sourceStability.verdict: STABLE - the trusted signal is consistent for one source across repeated requests, so it is usable as a bucket key.

results.totalHeaderCount: 17 baseline, 18 when the caller adds one forgeable header - consistent with pass-through of unknown headers

gapResolution.G1_forgeability: RESOLVED - cf-connecting-ip cannot be caller-supplied; the attempt is refused with 403 at the Cloudflare edge and the function never runs.
gapResolution.G3_functionRuntimeView: RESOLVED - cf-connecting-ip IS present in the Deno runtime's req.headers on every successful call.
gapResolution.G4_ipv6: STILL OPEN - this host has no native IPv6 route to supabase.co (curl -6 resolved to an IPv4-mapped address), so IPv6 transport was never genuinely exercised. Pseudo IPv4 status for real IPv6 clients remains UNDETERMINED.

correctionsToFDA028_GAB_2: TRUSTED_INPUT must be cf-connecting-ip alone. The rightmost-x-forwarded-for-under-pinned-hop-count rule is wrong for this platform.
The x-real-ip corroborating cross-check is IMPOSSIBLE - x-real-ip does not reach the function.
true-client-ip and forwarded are caller-forgeable at the function and must be explicitly ignored.
request.cf is unreachable, so it cannot serve as a structured anchor.
A single-value assertion replaces the hop-count assertion: cf-connecting-ip is always exactly one element.
